folds.heading: ## Detailed trial reconciliation, 2026-11-04 (B176)
folds.body:
The full real-task, harness-fixed, harness-finished, code-fix-final, workflow-improvement-final and fresh-code-fix reports were read, including their failed intermediate attempts and instrumentation corrections. Preserve the progression rather than describing every later result as either original failure or general unattended success. The first Harness task ended max-tokens with no artifact; direct code generation then passed15 independent assertions after primary execution. Settings replay produced correct artifacts but was supervisor-aborted at the step boundary despite process exit0. The final bounded inventory task did run its fixed checker and finish normally, six steps/seven requests, at111.255 warm seconds. A preceding script passed its own revised tests but failed the unchanged duplicate-list edge oracle14/15; that failed artifact remains retained.

The actual launcher code fix was useful and locally integrated, with a meaningful old-source/new-regression failure and9 focused tests, but needed a corrected primary brief, functional repair after breaking a mock and a close-out prompt. The follow-on same-defect replay produced a smaller candidate and normal bounded continuation; it did not replace the adopted project patch or qualify a held-out task. The later PID-liveness task was a separate fresh success: one human message, zero follow-ups, seven steps/eight requests, first verification pass and normal completion at93.925 seconds, with four meaningful new regressions and10 lane tests. Mocked process operations do not signal real agents. That is one supported no-follow-up case, not a reliability rate.

Keep intervention and verification ownership exact: code-only direct recovery leaves execution/testing with primary; a worker-run fixed checker is different from primary independent assessment; a durable conversation is not file rollback. Step counts differ from backend requests and a reactive ninth-step termination is not a strict request-admission controller. Backend off controls and unchanged-body relay observed zero emitted reasoning for the named tasks, not inaccessible internal computation. The first reasoning-field counter and later persona-shadowing speculation were corrected from retained evidence; do not revive them as established causes. Reported latency excludes substantial setup/review and mixes warm/context/scaffolding conditions, so no causal runner ranking, token saving or net human-time saving follows.

The tested verification helper records actual command statuses and input/output hashes, rejects changed sources, stops later checks on failure and exposes bounded diagnostics; it grants no permissions or sandbox guarantee. Shell pipelines can hide earlier failure, so the final required check statuses matter. Fixture helper tests do not prove every model uses the helper, and YAML/frontmatter parsing is not a passed Python skill validator. Registry counts are configured facts, not installed/probed tool health. Old model digests/settings/PIDs/ports are historical, not current configuration advice or authority to edit another project’s skill. No inference, replay, tool probe, live model/settings lookup, raw wire/private backup access, installation or new agent was performed.
